notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a four-page primary Final Report titled Replication of a Research Claim from Ballard et al. (2016), from the Journal of Applied Psychology, dated September 30, 2021. Replication team Vasiliy Safin and Michael Losi, Research Scientist Melissa Kline; claim explicitly attributed to Ballard et al. (2016). SOURCE URL https://osf.io/download/qu793/ matches the supplied replication file identifier. Title, team overlap, project identity and document type establish the requested replication report. Supplied reference has a broader author list and November 18, 2025 date, not established by this document. Target follows selected claim and primary-analysis description, independently of row order or numeric matching. Primary result prints Beta = -0.46, p < 0.001. Separate sensitivity analysis excluding two online participants prints Beta = - 0.53, p < 0.001. Coefficient retained without conversion or inferred standardisation. Same-test p retained in evidence/notes only; n and p core fields are unassigned placeholders. Authors specify a significance-and-pattern criterion and report a significant interaction, but provide no explicit overall replication-success category; no category inferred solely from significance.
